proof_pending.heading: Assessment pending
proof_pending.description: Evidence received; assessment has not finished.

needs_more_evidence.heading: More evidence needed
needs_more_evidence.description: Check missing information, remaining attempts and the deadline.

review_pending.heading: Under review
review_pending.description: The case awaits a decision; this is not a miss.

fulfilled.heading: Fulfilled
fulfilled.description: View the confirmed outcome and awarded XP.

missed.heading: Missed
missed.description: Earlier XP remains. Recovery is offered only while eligible.

recovered.heading: Recovered
recovered.description: Recovery completed; the earlier missed Oath remains in history.

unresolved.heading: Unresolved
unresolved.description: No new XP and no miss. An already activated Recovery keeps its rules.

withdrawn.heading: Withdrawn
withdrawn.description: No XP and no miss. Resuming does not restore this commitment.
